name: world.jobo/job-search
title: Jobo Job Search
description: Search a live index of millions of open jobs from employer career sites and 200+ ATS platforms.

environmentVariables.name: PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port for the local HTTP server (default 3002).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_RESOURCE_URL
environmentVariables.description: The base URL clients reach this server at, without /mcp, e.g. http://localhost:3002. It is the resource the server's OAuth metadata names, and a client refuses to sign in when that differs from the URL it connected to. Default https://jobs-mcp.jobo.world, the hosted server.

packageArguments.name: --stdio
packageArguments.description: Serve MCP over stdio and sign in with an API key (local mode).

environmentVariables.name: JOBO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Jobo API key, from https://enterprise.jobo.world/api-keys. Searches are billed to its account per job returned.
